href="//lf-package-sg.larksuitecdn.com/obj/lark-static-sgsaas/lark/open/doc/frontend/styles/app-de0e9617.css" rel="stylesheet"><style>#sc-cookie-banner {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 30px;
  right: 30px;
  z-index: 2147483647;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--token-bg-content-base, #f8f9fa);
  box-shadow: 0px 4px 10px 0px rgba(28, 41, 86, 0.06), 0px 12px 24px 0px rgba(28, 41, 86, 0.08);
  width: 514px;
  padding: 24px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  background: #fff;
  font-family: 'Lark Circular', 'Notosans Regular', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei',
    Tahoma, Arial;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#sc-cookie-banner * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-main {
  transition: all 0.3s;
  opacity: 1;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-content {
  flex: 1 1 0;
}
.sc-cookie-banner-title {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 24px;
}
.sc-cookie-banner-desc {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 22px;
  color: #646a73;
}
.sc-cookie-banner-desc > a {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: #1456f0;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  text-decoration: underline;
  transition: color 0.3s;
}
.sc-cookie-banner-desc > a:hover {
  color: rgb(78 131 253);
}
.sc-cookie-banner-desc > a:active {
  color: rgb(36, 91, 219);
}
.sc-cookie-banner-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 30px;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-btn {
  font-family: 'Lark Circular', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Tahoma, Arial;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 40px;
  line-height: 32px;
  padding: 8px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 14px;
  background: none;
  border: 2px solid #5083fb;
  color: #336df4;
  min-width: 150px;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  outline: none;
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  text-decoration: none;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  transition: color 0.1s ease-in, background-color 0.1s ease-in, border-color 0.1s ease-in, width 0.2s ease-in;
  user-select: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-btn:hover {
  background: #e0e9ff;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-btn:active {
  background: #c2d4ff;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-accept-btn {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: #3370ff;
  border-color: #3370ff;
}
.sc-cookie-banner-accept-btn:hover {
  border-color: rgb(78, 131, 253);
  background: rgb(78, 131, 253);
}
.sc-cookie-banner-accept-btn:active {
  border-color: rgb(36, 91, 219);
  background: rgb(36, 91, 219);
}
.sc-cookie-banner-reject-btn {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: #3370ff;
  border-color: #3370ff;
}

.sc-cookie-banner-reject-btn:hover {
  background: rgb(78, 131, 253);
}
.sc-cookie-banner-reject-btn:active {
  background: rgb(78, 131, 253);
}

.sc-cookie-banner-manage-btn {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #3370ff;
  border-color: #3370ff;
}
.sc-toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 10000;
  top: 32px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  text-align: center;
}
.sc-toast {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 15px 19px;
  background-color: rgb(240, 251, 239);
  border: 1px solid rgb(52, 199, 36);
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: rgb(31, 35, 41);
  font-size: 14px;
  box-shadow: rgba(31, 35, 41, 0.04) 0px 8px 24px 8px, rgba(31, 35, 41, 0.04) 0px 6px 12px 0px,
    rgba(31, 35, 41, 0.06) 0px 4px 8px -8px;
  font-family: 'Notosans Regular', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', Tahoma, Arial;
}
.sc-toast-icon {
  color: rgb(52, 199, 36);
  margin-top: 3px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
@media screen and (max-width: 850px) {
  #sc-cookie-banner {
    right: 12px;
    bottom: 16px;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-main {
    transition: all 0.3s;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-desc {
    margin-right: 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 16px;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-actions {
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: row-reverse;
    margin-top: 18px;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-actions-default-reject {
    flex-direction: row;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-actions > * {
    margin: 12px 0 0 0;
  }
  .sc-cookie-banner-btn {
    width: 100%;
    height: 36px;
  }
}

#sc-cookie-banner[data-collapse='true'] {
  width: 46px;
  max-width: 46px !important;
  max-height: 46px !important;
  border-radius: 24px;
  right: 30px;
  bottom: 30px;
  padding: 23px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#sc-cookie-banner[data-collapse='true']:hover {
  background: #f5f8ff;
}

#sc-cookie-banner[data-collapse='true'] > .sc-cookie-banner-main {
  opacity: 0;
}

#sc-cookie-banner[data-collapse='true']::before {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 14px;
  background-image: url(data:image/svg+xml;base64,);
}

can create a task. When creating a task, it supports filling in the basic information of the task (such as title, description, person in charge, etc.). In addition, it can also set the start time of the task, deadline reminders and other conditions. In addition, you can pass in the tasklists field to add new tasks to multiple lists.</p><p>When creating a task, "assignees" and "followers" can be added by specifying <code class="md-render_code-inline">members</code> fields. For the format of member, please refer to the " How to represent members of tasks and tasklists?" section in <a href="/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/task-v2/tasklist/overview" class="internal-link" target="_self">Feature Overview</a> .</p><p>When setting task start or due time, you need to follow the specification and constraints of task time. Please refer to the "How to use start and due time?" section in <a href="/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/task-v2/tasklist/overview" class="internal-link" target="_self">Feature Overview</a> .</p><p>This api supports "idempotent invocation" by specifying <code class="md-render_code-inline">client_token</code> field. Please refer to the "Idempotent Invocation" section in <a href="/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/task-v2/tasklist/overview" class="internal-link" target="_self">Feature Overview</a> .</p><p>To create a subtask of a task, you need to use the <a href="/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/task-v2/task-subtask/create" class="internal-link" target="_self">Create Subtask</a> API.</p><p>Creating tasks allows setting custom field values at the same time. However, according to the authorization model of custom fields, only values of fields associated with tasklists can only be added to tasks. Please refer to <a href="/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/task-v2/custom_field/custom-field-overview" class="internal-link" target="_self">Custom Field Feature Overview</a> for details.<span class="md-render_api-explorer md-render_api-explorer--disabled"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="md-render_api-explorer__debug"><path d="M10.461 6.53334C10.7721 6.76667 10.7721 7.23334 10.461 7.46667L5.01659 11.55C4.63203 11.8384 4.08325 11.564 4.08325 11.0833L4.08325 2.91667C4.08325 2.43597 4.63203 2.16159 5.01659 2.45L10.461 6.53334Z" fill="white"></path></svg><div class="md-render_api-explorer__content">Try It</div></span></p><div class="md-alert-wrapper"><div class="md-alert md-alert-tip"><svg fill="currentColor" width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 20 20" class="md-alert-icon"><path d="M10 19.167A9.167 9.167 0 1010 .834a9.167 9.167 0 000 18.333zM9.583 7.084a.417.417 0 01-.417-.417v-.833a.417.417 0 01.417-.417h.833a.417.417 0 01.417.417v.833a.417.417 0 01-.417.417h-.833zm-.417 5.833V9.584H8.75a.417.417 0 01-.417-.417v-.833a.417.417 0 01.417-.417h1.666a.415.415 0 01.417.417v4.583h.833a.416.416 0 01.417.417v.833a.417.417 0 01-.417.417H8.333a.415.415 0 01-.417-.417v-.833a.416.416 0 01.417-.417h.833z" fill="#3370FF"></path></svg><div class="md-alert-content" id="tips[0].tipInfo"><p>If want to add new created task to several tasklists, the calling identity must have edit permission on all these tasklists.
